items.title: Section: Dependent Origination Is Entirely True-Reality Engagement — No Confident Understanding Required

items.zh: 謂我今此純大苦蘊，亦如是生。又我自體無邊無際，從先際來初不可知，亦如是生。彼諸有情去、來、現在一切自體，苦蘊所攝，亦皆如是已生、當生。如是緣性緣起正觀，一切皆是真實作意，更無所餘勝解作意。
items.en: "This entire mass of suffering that is my own body and mind has likewise arisen in just this way. And my own existence, boundless and without limit, whose beginning cannot be known from beginningless time past, has likewise arisen in just this way. All the past, future, and present bodies of these other beings, belonging to the mass of suffering, have likewise already arisen, and will arise, in just this way." This correct contemplation of conditioned dependent origination is, in its entirety, true-reality engagement — there remains no further confident-understanding engagement apart from it.

items.zh: 若於自身現在諸蘊緣性緣生作意思惟，是名於內身、受、心、法住彼循觀。若於他身現在諸蘊緣性緣生作意思惟，是名於外身、受、心、法住彼循觀。若於自他過去、未來所有諸蘊緣性緣生作意思惟，名於內外身、受、心、法住彼循觀。餘如前說。

items.title: Section: Elemental Analysis Opens — Grasping Each of the Six Elements, Outer Then Inner

items.zh: 又於界差別觀初修業者，先取其外所有堅相。所謂大地、山林、草木、塼石、瓦礫、末尼、真珠、琉璃、螺貝、珊瑚、玉等。取彼相已，復於內堅而起勝解。次取其外諸大水相。所謂江、河、眾流、陂、湖、池、沼、井等。取彼相已，復於內濕而起勝解。次取其外諸大火相。所謂熱時，烈日炎熾，焚燒山澤，災火蔓莚，窯室等中所有諸火。取彼相已，復於內煗而起勝解。次取其外諸大風相。所謂東西南北等風，乃至風輪。取彼相已，復於內風而起勝解。次取其外諸大空相。所謂諸方無障無礙，諸聚色中孔隙、窟穴，有所容受。善取如是空界相已，於內空界而起勝解。
items.en: "A beginner cultivating elemental-analysis contemplation first grasps the outer marks of solidity — the great earth, mountains, forests, grass, and trees … having grasped these marks, one then generates vivid understanding of the solidity within. Next, one grasps the outer marks of the great waters — rivers, streams, and their many tributaries … generating vivid understanding of the moisture within. Next, one grasps the outer marks of great fire … generating vivid understanding of the warmth within. Next, one grasps the outer marks of great wind … generating vivid understanding of the wind within. Next, one grasps the outer marks of great space … generating vivid understanding of the space within."

items.zh: 後由聞思增上力故，起細分別，取識界相。所謂內眼處不壞，外色處現前，若無能生作意正起，所生眼識亦不得生。與是相違，眼識得生。如是乃至意、法、意識，當知亦爾。取是相已，次起勝解，了知如是四大身中，有一切識諸種子、界、種性、自性。

items.title: From Coarse to Subtle: Analysing the Body Down to Its Smallest Particles

items.zh: 又於如是四大種中，先起支節麁大勝解，後起分析種種細分微細勝解。如是漸次分析，乃至向遊塵量，如是漸漸乃至極微而起勝解。一一支分尚起無量最極微塵積集勝解，何況身中一切支分。
items.en: "Further, within these four great elements, one first generates vivid understanding of the coarse, large limbs and joints, and afterwards generates vivid understanding by analysing them into ever finer, subtler divisions. Analysing in this way, step by step, down to the measure of a mote of dust drifting in sunlight, one generates vivid understanding all the way down to the subtlest particle. Even a single limb, thus analysed, is understood as an accumulation of boundless subtlest particles — how much more so every limb throughout the entire body."

items.zh: 如是名為界差別觀中，分析諸色界差別邊際微細勝解。次於空界，先當發起所有麁大空界勝解。所謂眼、耳、鼻、喉筒等種種竅穴，由是吞咽、於是吞咽，既吞咽已，由是下分不淨流出。次後漸漸發起種種微細勝解，乃至身中一切微細諸毛孔穴，皆悉了知。後於識界，漸漸發起所依、所緣，及以作意三世時分品類差別無量勝解。即於識界起勝解時，由諸所依所緣勝解分析識界。亦於十種所造諸色而起勝解。如諸大種微細分析，此亦如是。若於自身各別諸界而起勝解，是名於內諸念住中住彼循觀。若於其餘非有情數所有諸界而起勝解，是名於外住彼循觀。若於其餘諸有情數所有諸界而起勝解，名於內外住彼循觀。復有異門。謂於己身而起勝解。

blocks.text: Dependent origination needs no imagined images: it is true reality from the start. Then the elements, outer and inner, coarse to subtle. Several short passages are untranslated.

"This correct contemplation of dependent origination is, in its entirety, true-reality engagement." "This mass of suffering that is my own body and mind has arisen in just this way." "My existence, whose beginning cannot be known, has likewise arisen in just this way."

"First grasp the outer marks of solidity: the great earth, mountains, forests, grass, and trees"; then "generate vivid understanding of the solidity within". Then the great waters, and the moisture within. Master Cháng Bǎi tells of practising water contemplation himself. Then fire, wind, space, and consciousness.

"First the coarse, large limbs and joints; afterwards, analysing them into ever finer divisions, step by step, down to the measure of a mote of dust drifting in sunlight", and further, to the subtlest particle. Master Cháng Bǎi notes that Mahāyāna texts treat such particles as mental constructs.

This is meditation as analysis. The body that feels so solid is shown, in imagination and then in understanding, to be elements, down to particles. The aim is not physics but the loosening of pride: there is no solid "I" to be proud of.

quiz.q: "This contemplation of dependent origination is entirely true-reality engagement." How do the masters contrast it with other contemplations?
options: Cháng Bǎi: loving-kindness and impurity pass from confident to true engagement, but dependent origination is wholly true; Miào Jìng: this contemplation matches the facts
quiz.why: "This correct contemplation of conditioned dependent origination is, in its entirety, true-reality engagement — there remains no further confident-understanding engagement." Master Cháng Bǎi: loving-kindness and impurity enter true engagement via confident understanding, but dependent origination is entirely true engagement. Venerable Miào Jìng: contemplating and reflecting this way matches the facts — it truly is so.

quiz.q: Contemplating "this mass of suffering arose likewise," how does Venerable Miào Jìng distinguish 緣生 from 緣起?
options: 緣生 refers to the result, 緣起 to the cause
quiz.why: "This entire mass of suffering that is my own body and mind has likewise arisen in just this way." Venerable Miào Jìng: 緣生 is spoken of the result — the fruit produced by conditions; 緣起 is spoken of the cause.

quiz.q: "My existence is boundless; its beginning cannot be known." What does Venerable Miào Jìng say?
options: when it began cannot be known — no first cause can be traced
quiz.why: "My own existence, boundless and without limit, whose beginning cannot be known from beginningless time past, has likewise arisen in just this way." Venerable Miào Jìng: when it began cannot be known — no first cause can be traced.

quiz.q: Elemental analysis grasps "the outer marks of great waters." Whose water-contemplation story does Master Cháng Bǎi tell?
options: Chan master Fajin, meditating in a hut, became entirely water in absorption
quiz.why: "Next, one grasps the outer marks of the great waters." Master Cháng Bǎi: he practised water contemplation in a mountain hut; in absorption his whole body became water.

quiz.q: Analysing "down to the 向遊塵." How does Venerable Miào Jìng explain the term?
options: 向 is a window; sunlight through it shows motes drifting — those are 遊塵
quiz.why: "Analysing in this way, step by step, down to the measure of a mote of dust drifting in sunlight, one generates vivid understanding all the way down to the subtlest particle." Venerable Miào Jìng: 向 is a window; when it opens and sunlight comes in, you see motes moving in space — these are 遊塵.

quiz.q: Analysing to the "subtlest particle," how does Master Cháng Bǎi say the Mahāyāna views it?
options: posited by analytical wisdom — a conceptual construct, since no smallest matter can be found
quiz.why: "One generates vivid understanding all the way down to the subtlest particle." Master Cháng Bǎi: but the Mahāyāna says the subtlest particle is posited by analytical wisdom — a conceptual construct, because no smallest matter can be found.

quiz.q: "First coarse limbs, then subtle divisions." What does Master Cháng Bǎi say analysis finally reveals?
options: even the smallest unit of form is unfindable — subtle understanding
quiz.why: "One first generates vivid understanding of the coarse, large limbs and joints, and afterwards generates vivid understanding by analysing them into ever finer divisions." Master Cháng Bǎi: analysing form down to its smallest unit, even that cannot be found — this is subtle understanding.
